title: HostSendOutboxEntry v1
description: One durable send-outbox entry of the host. The rpcId is a lowercase UUIDv4 generated at enqueue and is the idempotency key of the user message; the entry is deleted only after an authoritative user_message with that source.rpcId has been observed. Optional attachments are references plus metadata, never inline bytes: bytes live under send-outbox/attachments/<rpcId>/<attachmentId> in the same durable app-container tree, not in Library/Caches and not in /dsh/tmp. The state machine, store lifecycle and crash rules are fixed by spec/host/v1/README.md section 10 and docs/protocol-changes/PC-20261112-w1-browse-outbox.md (Rev 3).

attachments.description: Optional attachment references. Ordered; at most 8. The bytes are outbox-owned files referenced by storePath; no inline bytes or dataBase64 member is allowed.
